tools.name: search_ecards
tools.description: Search public animated card designs from the events and creative IDs currently enabled in the server MCP card catalog configuration. Every design suits every language. Use fr for French creative names, en for default names for all other languages. Returns posters and design demos, not personalized d

tools.name: prepare_ecard
tools.description: Save or update an owned text-only draft or published card using only creative IDs currently enabled in the server MCP card catalog configuration. Cards support a separate optional title and required message and signature. Suggest title and message when appropriate without unnecessary questions. Reci

tools.name: list_ecards
tools.description: List cards and drafts created through BeingSo MCP by the connected account, newest first. Returns titles, recipient names, creation times, revisions and draft_ids with pagination. Use to find a previously created card, then get_ecard to recover its content and sharing links. Does not include cards c

tools.name: get_ecard
tools.description: Retrieve an owned MCP card or draft using its draft_id. Returns the latest revision, reviewed content, preview and, when published, its stable public URL and sharing options. Use before adding email recipient details to an existing published card. Does not send email.

tools.name: publish_ecard
tools.description: Publish the exact reviewed draft revision as a public personalized card without sending or scheduling email. Requires a verified account. Returns card_url, sender share_page_url and sharing_methods. Offer these options and any messaging, email or social tools available to you, then ask which method

tools.name: send_ecard
tools.description: Request dispatch of the exact reviewed draft revision. Requires a verified sender. Recipient, message and time cannot be replaced here. Reuse the idempotency key on retries. Acceptance creates a durable request only; never report pending_handoff as sent or as transport acceptance.

tools.name: get_ecard_status
tools.description: Read an owned dispatch receipt by dispatch_id. Distinguishes transport acceptance and remote-content activity. A tracking-pixel or playback request may be caused by a mail proxy or scanner and never proves human reading.

tools.name: cancel_scheduled_ecard
tools.description: Cancel an owned pending dispatch request before worker claiming. Preserves its cancellation receipt. Repeated cancellation is safe; once processing begins cancellation is too late.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_ecard" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "index.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_ecards, get_ecard · Public sink: prepare_ecard, list_ecards, get_ecard, publish_ecard, send_ecard.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_ecards, get_ecard · Public sink: prepare_ecard, list_ecards, get_ecard, publish_ecard, send_ecard

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
